explicacion: "Nacer" se dice **was born**, siempre con *was* o *were*.

es: Estuve en Cusco hace tres años.
natural: I was in Cusco three years ago.
calco: I was in Cusco ago three years.
I was sick the last week.
explicacion: "La semana pasada" es **last week**, sin *the*. *The last week* es "la última semana".
**Was** y **were** arman la pregunta solos, sin *did*.
